Profile
Education is the training of the Intellect, refinement of the Heart and discipline of the Mind   -    Radhakrishnan
Education deals with the ever-growing man in an ever-growing society.  With this motto the Department of Education was established in the year of 1985 under the umbrella of Goalpara College. The department was first affiliated in 1992 and the Major courses were introduced in 2000.
The courses offered by the department are:
•	Higher Secondary 2 years course
•	Bachelor of Arts (Major& General)
•	CBCS Honours and Generic/Regular (since   2019 onwards)
•	Skill Enhancement Course (SEC)
There are more than 800 students in total, are enrolled (each year) in various classes of the dept. The dept followed Assamese as well as English language as the medium of instruction. Along with the conventional method, LCD Projector and Computers are being used for comprehensive teaching – learning in the Smart classrooms. The department has a Laboratory Room for conducting Psychological Practical classes with required.
Equipments: The department possess a Departmental Library with more than 200 subject related as well as reference books and also has a subscription of a monthly journal EDUTRACK.
The department has been taking utmost care in organising Seminars, Group Discussions, workshop. extension activities etc. for developing students’ presentation skills and self-confidence. The dept also organise Freshman Social programme at the beginning and Field-trip cum Picnic at the end of the session for all round development of students. The students of the dept get opportunity to express their ideas and thoughts as Articles through the Wall Magazine “JAGRITI”.
There are three permanent faculty members one part time faculty and one bearer working in the Department:
1.    Dr. Chintamayee Sarangi (Head) Associate Prof.
2.    Mrs.  Rupjyoti Das                          Assistant Prof.
3.    Mr.   Gobinda Das                          Assistant Prof.
4.    Ms.  Antara Lahkar                         Assistant Prof.
5.     Sri Bijay Rabha                              (Lab-Bearer).
